name: @veren/graph-flow-api
description: Use when you write a flow node-type plugin or need the flow semantic-layer vocabulary against the DAG kernel: it declares the type-only surface (FlowDefinition, NodeHandler, branded FlowId/RunId/NodeId, the blackboard contract, the FlowEngine/RunHandle shapes) plus the NodeRegistry token and a registerNodeHandler helper; skip it when you need the engine implementation — node plugins must depend only on this package and never on @veren/graph-flow-engine.
